macro.m_description: Nayi jagah par 20 minute ke baad unlock par ek sawal: is jagah ka naam (Dukan / Ghar…). Naam sirf phone mein rehta hai. Din mein 1 dafa; 0 = yeh jagah kabhi na poochho. AI nahi.

m_actionList.title: 📍 Yeh kaun si jagah hai?
m_actionList.text: Aap yahan kuch der se hain. Is jagah ka naam rakh dein (jaise Dukan, Ghar, Godam 1) — aage yahan ki cheezein isi naam ke folder mein jayengi.

m_actionList.m_userPromptMessage: Jaise: Dukan · Ghar · Godam 1. (0 likhein = yeh jagah dobara na poochho.)
